integrity: The infinite assertion is established by a self-contained inclusion-exclusion and stochastic-coupling proof; finite exact enumeration independently probes boundary cases. No independent external audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Conditioned on inclusion of the designated vertex; no reconstruction of the whole graph or full domination polynomial. Strict ordering needs two distinct feasible overlaps. The general degree-sum inequality is not asserted original; only its sharp equality condition in this class. Related unindexed literature is a remaining originality risk.
title: Two-hole local domination profiles and sharp stochastic overlap order
